# The engine_sync model of copies in ignored folders must follow the driver where the disk lost a folder the user deleted around entries that exist only in L: the driver keeps that folder as lost (Trees::keep_lost_local) and removes it once a scan places the last entry recorded below it (core/driver/src/engine.rs). The model kept such folders with ignore_local and never removed them, so a deleted folder stayed in L after the rules let its entry in again. The added lines model that removal and extend a_folder_deleted_around_only_a_moved_away_entry_leaves_nothing_on_disk to lift the exclusion; no other test reaches a lost folder in the model.
